_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Parts, Materials, and Processes Selection List (PMPSL)
summary: This DID describes the content and format requirements for a list of all Parts, Materials, and Processes (PMP) approved for design in a specific contract.
description_purpose: This Data Item Description (DID) describes the content and format requirements for a list of all Parts, Materials, and Processes (PMP) approved for design in a specific contract.
application_interrelationship: This Data Item Description contains the format and content preparation instructions for data resulting from the work task described by paragraph 5.3 and Appendix D of MIL-STD-1546B
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval date, and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content and format.
preparation_instructions.content: The PMPSL shall be in accordance with MIL-STD-1546B paragraph 5.3 and Appendix D. The PMPSL shall be divided into four sections that describe electronic parts, mechanical parts, materials, and processes. Appendix D of MIL-STD-1546B contains the detailed information that shall be provided for each of these sections and the electromagnetic medium submittal requirements.
